notes.title: New Release date: Feb 10th 2022
notes.notes:
Listen up, rookies! Time Patrol launch date is finally set to be on February 10th!

Two weeks from now, we will be releasing the game on Steam and you'll be able to get your hands dirty. Time to start shining your weapons. And no travelling to the future timeline before it's time!
